column1: # p230 T230-A2 - FORK DIRECTION settled by the COPYRIGHT LINE, a channel p228 ruled out
# for hashes and did not consider for holders.
# p228's rule, and it is correct: a licence-body HASH never evidences an alias, because it
# fingerprints the CANONICAL TEXT. anthropics/k12-teacher-skills and UniTime/unitime serve a
# byte-identical Apache-2.0 body and are unrelated projects.
# But an MIT or BSD body is NOT canonical text alone: its third line carries a COPYRIGHT
# HOLDER, and that names a PROJECT. Where two slugs share a body hash AND that body names
# one of the two owners, the direction is settled by a single read.
# This does NOT work for GPL/AGPL/LGPL/EPL: their canonical bodies carry the FSF's or the
# Eclipse Foundation's copyright, never the project's. The discriminator is family-bound.
